references.text: Luke 24:52 describes the disciples returning to Jerusalem (their hometown) with great joy after an event, a parallel to going each to their own home.
Matthew 26:56 tells that the disciples left Jesus and fled each to their own, sharing the motif of going each to their own home after a decisive event.
Mark 14:50 has an almost identical formulation about the disciples leaving him and fleeing, each to their own, which mirrors the action in John 7:53.
